analysis.reasonEn: Maintained wait-and-see for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI at 46.1 settled in neutral zone, lacking further upward momentum after exiting oversold. MACD histogram improving but not yet positive. ADX at 29.8 indicates a clear trend, but -DI at 30.5 is stronger than +DI at 24.2, showing downward pressure. Positioned at 41.1% of 52-week range, near the lower bound. Risk-reward ratio unfavorable for entry: downside to swing support at 85,300 (1.8x ATR) vs. upside to swing resistance at 95,720 (0.6x ATR), both below 1.5:1. Therefore, maintaining wait-and-see.
